_meta.purpose: Historical public-key registry for notary receipt verification (core/proof_endpoint.cjs). Public keys only, never private material. Lets old receipts keep verifying across a future key rotation by resolving each receipt's own notary_fp field against the key that was active when it was signed, instead of always checking against whatever key is current.

how_to_use: Each receipt carries its own notary_fp. Resolve that fingerprint against this keys[] array (by fingerprint) to get the exact public_key_pem active when it was signed -- do NOT assume the CURRENT key (or whatever /health returns right now) is correct for a receipt signed under a prior key. Verify entirely offline: recompute receipt_hash, then crypto.verify(null, Buffer.from(receipt_hash), resolved_public_key_pem, Buffer.from(signature,"base64")).
